observations: Photo 0 shows a V8 engine with a black plastic cover, various hoses, and metal components. A small label with '4600' is visible on the engine cover.
Photo 1 shows the same engine from a different angle, with more visible components including the oil cap and alternator. The engine appears used, with grime and wear.

The engine has no visible branding or model name on the cover or block in any photo.
